'import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

required = {"DATE_TIME", "DIA_SEMANA", "HORA", "USERS"}
if not required.issubset(dataset.columns):
    raise ValueError("Faltan campos: {}".format(sorted(required - set(dataset.columns))))
data = dataset.copy()
data["DATE_TIME"] = pd.to_datetime(data["DATE_TIME"], errors="raise").dt.round("s")
data["USERS"] = pd.to_numeric(data["USERS"], errors="raise")
data["DIA_SEMANA"] = pd.to_numeric(data["DIA_SEMANA"], errors="raise")
time_text = data["HORA"].astype(str).str.extract(
    r"(?<!\d)((?:[01]?\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d:[0-5]\d(?:\.\d+)?)", expand=False)
data["HORA_INT"] = pd.to_timedelta(time_text, errors="raise").dt.round("s").dt.components["hours"]
if data["DATE_TIME"].isna().any() or data["DATE_TIME"].duplicated().any():
    raise ValueError("DATE_TIME debe identificar una sola observación por hora.")
if not data["USERS"].between(0, float("inf"), inclusive="left").all():
    raise ValueError("USERS contiene valores nulos, negativos o no finitos.")
sql_day = (data["DATE_TIME"].dt.dayofweek + 1) % 7 + 1
if not data["DIA_SEMANA"].eq(sql_day).all():
    raise ValueError("DIA_SEMANA no coincide con la fecha (SQL: domingo=1).")
if not data["HORA_INT"].eq(data["DATE_TIME"].dt.hour).all():
    raise ValueError("HORA no coincide con DATE_TIME.")

order = [2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 1]  # Lunes a domingo según DIM_FECHA.
index = pd.MultiIndex.from_product([order, range(24)], names=["DIA_SEMANA", "HORA_INT"])
groups = data.groupby(["DIA_SEMANA", "HORA_INT"])["USERS"]
mean = groups.mean().reindex(index).reset_index(drop=True)
q25 = groups.quantile(0.25).reindex(index).reset_index(drop=True)
q75 = groups.quantile(0.75).reindex(index).reset_index(drop=True)

plt.rcParams.update({"font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 9})
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 2.55))
if data.empty:
    ax.set_axis_off()
    ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "Sin datos para el conjunto seleccionado", ha="center", va="center",
            transform=ax.transAxes, color="#173C66")
else:
    ax.plot(range(168), mean, color="#1764AB", linewidth=1.6, label="Promedio")
    ax.plot(range(168), q25, linestyle="dashed", color="#758495", linewidth=1, label="Cuantil 25")
    ax.plot(range(168), q75, linestyle="dashed", color="#A1ADBA", linewidth=1, label="Cuantil 75")
    ax.set(title="Promedio de usuarios a largo de la semana",
           xticks=[i * 24 for i in range(7)],
           xticklabels=["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"],
           xlabel="Día y hora de la semana", ylabel="Número de usuarios", xlim=(0, 167))
    ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
    ax.grid(axis="y", color="#DCE4ED", linewidth=0.6)
    for boundary in range(24, 168, 24):
        ax.axvline(boundary, color="#E7ECF2", linewidth=0.6, zorder=0)
    ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
    ax.legend(loc="upper right", ncol=3, fontsize=8, frameon=False)
    ax.set_title("Promedio de usuarios a largo de la semana", color="#173C66", pad=10)
fig.tight_layout(pad=1.1)
plt.show()
'
